FAQ

Questions you might have.

If yours isn't here, write to wavesbychin@gmail.com and it will be answered directly.

Before you book

Every session is a little different, but most begin with settling in: some gentle breathwork or a short grounding moment. Then I play seven Tibetan singing bowls, often bringing them close so you feel the sound as well as hear it.

Some people fall asleep, some feel calm, and others feel very little the first time. All of that is normal, and there's nothing you need to do but rest and listen.

No. Sound healing, reiki and breathwork are wellness practices, not medical treatment. If you have a specific health concern, please continue working with your doctor or therapist alongside any sessions with me.

Sound healing is gentle and suits most people. However, it is not suitable if any of the following apply to you:

  • You're pregnant.
  • You have epilepsy or a seizure condition.
  • You have a pacemaker, metal implants or have had recent surgery.
  • You have tinnitus or sound sensitivity.

If you're unsure whether sound healing is right for you, please get in touch before booking.

During a session

You settle onto a mat, we breathe for a few minutes, then I play seven Tibetan singing bowls while you rest and listen. I bring the bowls close so you feel the sound as well as hear it; just say if you'd prefer more distance.
Yes. I shape each session around the group and the time we have, so let me know if there's something you're drawn to or want to include.

After your session

Drink plenty of water. Have a big glass straight away, then keep sipping steadily through the rest of the day. It helps you rehydrate and feel grounded after deep relaxation.
Your body has shifted into rest mode, so this is completely normal. Sit for a moment, feel your feet on the floor, drink some water and have a light snack. Plan a quiet evening if you can.
Yes. Deep relaxation can bring feelings to the surface. Let them pass without judgement. If something difficult stays with you, reach out to a friend or a qualified professional.
Every session is different. Some people notice a lot, some very little, and both are fine.
Keep things gentle. Go easy on alcohol, strong caffeine, heavy meals and screens.

Corporate

Yes — I run sound healing sessions for corporate wellness days, offsites, and team wellbeing weeks. Sessions can be adapted for group size and available space.
Yes, and travel is included in the price.

Booking & practical

Every session is unique. Email me at wavesbychin@gmail.com with what you have in mind (the kind of session, how many people, where and when) and I'll send you a quote.

Sessions aren't cancelled, but they can be rescheduled. Let me know as early as you can and we'll find another date that works.
Wear comfortable, loose clothing you can relax in. What to bring depends on the venue. Some provide mats, cushions and blankets. If it doesn't, please bring your own mat, cushion or blanket to lie on.

Credentials

I'm a certified sound healing practitioner (trained in Nepal), a Reiki Level 2 practitioner (trained in London), and I've completed Pranic Healing Levels 1–3, a structured training in energy-based techniques for relaxation and stress relief.
